prompt.project_info: Single 2x2 sports-selfie collage adapted from the source prompt and folder context.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult original blonde athletic woman with natural minimal makeup, slightly flushed realistic skin and sporty ponytail or loose athletic hair; wearing a neutral or soft-tone athletic sports bra or fitted workout top with high-waisted leggings or athletic shorts.
prompt.composition_elements: 2x2 grid with four distinct smartphone-front-camera panels: top-left slight upward angle and relaxed smile; top-right side angle and subtle grin; bottom-left straight-on selfie with a soft smile; bottom-right slightly downward angle with a laugh or mid-smile. Use gym equipment or open athletic space as blurred backgrounds.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural or overhead gym lighting, uneven realistic exposure, casual sports-selfie energy and no studio polish.
prompt.technical_specs: Single 4:5 collage image, medium-low resolution, slightly soft sharpness, visible film grain, limited dynamic range, slightly warm white balance, minor motion blur, uneven framing and subtle smartphone lens distortion.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create one 4:5 2x2 sports-selfie collage of a clearly adult original blonde athletic woman with minimal makeup, flushed realistic skin and sporty hair, wearing neutral soft-tone athletic clothing. Top-left is a slight upward selfie with relaxed smile, top-right a side angle with subtle grin, bottom-left straight-on soft smile, bottom-right slightly downward angle with laughter; use blurred gym or open sports backgrounds, smartphone front-camera quality, visible grain, limited dynamic range, uneven framing and authentic imperfections.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity likeness, biometric identity, heavy retouching, AI beauty filter, studio lighting, high-end camera look, logos, text, watermark, extra fingers, distorted faces, duplicate panels
